title: A Thank You !!!
body:
Thank you for constantly looking for ways to enhance the congruity, convenience and profitableness of this outstanding app...!!!! I have one thing to ask though: Is it possible to add a Pie or Bar graph in order for us to vividly see the status of our everyday habits ? Thank you again for your hard work henokasfaw

I had fewer tasks to complete on weekends but the application notification shows me all tasks of the whole week…how can I fix that ?
author: HA0210
